title: Service-to-service authentication for kanbus-api (IAM SigV4) alongside the user JWT authorizer

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chatticus requirements (2026-10-20): (a) one deployment per Chatticus environment; the Chatticus service principal is granted every tenant of that deployment. (b) Delegated actor: the service principal passes the acting party in header X-Kanbus-Actor, honored ONLY for service principals holding an actor-delegation grant (users cannot set it); Kanbus records it verbatim as creator, comment author and event actor_id. Format: <namespace>:<kind>:<id>, validated against ^[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+:[A-Za-z0-9-_.]{1,128}$, e.g. chatticus:user:<uuid>, chatticus:bot:<uuid>. A missing header on a delegating principal is 400; the header on a non-delegating principal is 403. Spec both.
